title: QUANTIFYING LANGUAGE MODELS' SENSITIVITY TO SPURIOUS FEATURES IN PROMPT DESIGN or: How I learned to start worrying about prompt formatting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance spread (variance in accuracy) of Large Language Models across multiple semantically equivalent prompt formats using a Bayesian optimization algorithm called FORMATSPREAD to quantify sensitivity to spurious formatting features.
Measuring the variation in a model's classification accuracy on a StereoSet-inspired stereotype benchmark task (task280) when exposed to different, semantically equivalent prompt formats.
